mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, it is currently 68 degrees and overcast at Badger Ridge Middle School, with a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The city has issued a scam alert warning residents about fraudulent requests for planning and permit fees; please note that the city only accepts payments by check at the Administration Building. Additionally, new sewer and stormwater rates have been approved to keep our utility infrastructure self-supporting and reliable.

There is a lot happening today, including the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems and trivia games at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park and more trivia fun.

In a noteworthy update from last Thursday, August 13, a 14-year-old boy was stopped by police for riding an electric dirt bike on the street, resulting in an educational conversation between officers and his father.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Double Strawberry.
